note: The FTP server response bytes from the fuzzer-controlled control connection are available in the response buffer used by SIZE parsing.
The parser skips the three-digit FTP code and space, pointing start at the fuzzer-controlled SIZE response payload.
The carriage return in the short 213 response is found immediately at start, making fdigit equal to start.
The code decrements fdigit before checking that it is still greater than start, violating the required lower-bound condition when CR is the first payload byte.
After the pre-decrement, ISDIGIT dereferences one byte before start, so the parser reads outside the intended response payload.
